guides.title: Accessible Error Announcement
guides.description: Synchronize programmatic accessibility states (like aria-invalid) with the visual :user-invalid state to ensure screen reader users receive error feedback only after interaction, mirroring the visual experience.

guides.title: Respect Operating System Text Scale
guides.description: Respect the operating system's text scale preference for a page so font sizes, layout, and rem-based measurements follow the user's accessibility settings.

guides.title: Language Detection
guides.description: Detect the language of user-generated content or already present site content.

guides.title: Language Model
guides.description: Run on-device natural language inference in the browser using the Prompt API, with streaming output, structured JSON responses, and multi-turn session management.

guides.title: Summarizer
guides.description: Summarize text content using the on-device Summarizer API.

guides.title: Translator
guides.description: Translate text between languages using the on-device Translator API.

guides.title: Animate to Intrinsic Sizes
guides.description: Smoothly animate interactive components (like accordions, menus, and expanding cards) to and from their natural dimensions.

guides.title: Calculate With Intrinsic Sizes
guides.description: Calculate the size of an element based on its intrinsic size, while ensuring it fits within given design constraints.

guides.title: Child State Based Styling
guides.description: Build a component that changes its styling based on the state of one of its child elements. For example, a component that renders in light or dark mode based on whether a theme toggle is checked (or not).

guides.title: Content Based Styling
guides.description: Build a component that changes its layout based on whether it contains specific child elements (or not). For example, if the component contains an image, use a multi-column layout, otherwise default to a single-column layout.

guides.title: Design Token Reactivity
guides.description: Define higher-order design tokens, like density modes (compact, comfortable, spacious) or themes and have descendant components react to changes directly and in component-appropriate ways.

guides.title: Styling siblings based on count and index
guides.description: Create dynamic visual spectrums or layout arrangements that automatically adapt to the number of elements in a group.

guides.title: Fluid Scaling
guides.description: Scale items like font size, spacing, and media sizes smoothly based on the parent container's size rather than using fixed breakpoints

guides.title: Individual Transform Properties
guides.description: Animate or override individual CSS transform properties (e.g. translate, rotate, scale) independently of other transform properties on a single element.

guides.title: Overflow Clipping Control
guides.description: Adjust the visible clipping boundary of an element to align with the content edge, padding edge, or border edge—or a specified offset from any of these—offering finer-grained control over how content is clipped.

guides.title: Reduce Style Repetition with CSS Functions
guides.description: Reduce excessive style repetition by encapsulating complex or dynamic styling logic into reusable functions (such as a function that computes a gradient based on a set of input parameters).

guides.title: Size Aware Styling
guides.description: Build a component whose styles can be conditionally dependent on its own width or height, rather than the width or height of the viewport. For example a card component that can change its layouts depending on how large it is, or a call-to-action button that can conditionally display helper text based on its width.

guides.title: Style Parent with :has()
guides.description: Style parent elements of a form field (e.g. labels or fieldsets) when the field is invalid.

guides.title: Semantic Component Adaptation
guides.description: Build components that adapt visual logic based on semantic context using CSS container style queries.

guides.title: Animated Select Picker
guides.description: Create a custom select component whose dropdown is animated. For example, the menu fades or slides into view, or the options animate upon selection.

guides.title: Build an address form that follows best practice
guides.description: Build an address form with correct autocomplete attributes and autofill support.

guides.title: Use the CSS :autofill pseudo-class to highlight form fields that have been autofilled by the browser and not edited by the user
guides.description: Use CSS to highlight form fields that have been autofilled by the browser and not edited by the user.

guides.title: Build a payment form that follows best practice
guides.description: Build a payment form that collects card details with correct autocomplete values and autofill support.

guides.title: Build a sign-in form that follows best practice
guides.description: Build a sign-in form with correct autocomplete values and autofill support.

guides.title: Build a sign-up form that follows best practice
guides.description: Build a sign-up form with correct autocomplete values and autofill support.

guides.title: Brand-Consistent Forms
guides.description: Match checkboxes, radio buttons, range sliders, and progress bars to your site's color palette without replacing them with custom components.

guides.title: Branded Select Styling
guides.description: Create custom select elements whose button, picker, arrow icon, and checkmark all seamlessly match your brand or design system's typography, colors, spacing, and border treatments.

guides.title: Button group
guides.description: Build a button group: a set of options (mutually exclusive or not) laid out horizontally and presented as visually connected buttons.

guides.title: Custom Select Picker Layouts
guides.description: Create custom select pickers whose options are positioned in unique or interesting ways, rather than the traditional stacked list of options.

guides.title: Form Fields Automatically Fit Contents
guides.description: Allow form fields to grow and shrink to fit the user input, e.g. as the user types or selects a different option. Apply maximum and minimum size limits to create dynamic and responsive form fields that conform with the page design.

guides.title: Forms
guides.description: Best practices for building accessible, secure, and user-friendly web forms. Use this guide when creating or modifying forms, inputs, and submission flows.

guides.title: IME-safe enter-to-submit
guides.description: Implement Enter-to-submit in textareas and single-line inputs (chat, search, inline rename) safely for IME (Input Method Editor) users to prevent submitting incomplete text.

guides.title: Required Field Feedback
guides.description: Provide error message for required form fields that were skipped or left empty *only* after user interaction, to avoid preemptive errors and ensure feedback is timely and contextually relevant to the user's flow.

guides.title: Rich Media Picker (Customizable Select)
guides.description: Create a custom select component whose options can contain complex HTML formatting (e.g. images, icons, and other rich formatting) rather than just plain text.

guides.title: Select Menu Interaction
guides.description: Validate that a non-default option has been chosen in a select menu only after the user has interacted with the control.

guides.title: Brand-Consistent Range Slider
guides.description: Style a native range slider with custom track, thumb, fill, and focus states while preserving native functionality and accessibility.

guides.title: SMS OTP form verification
guides.description: Verify user phone numbers and one-time passcodes delivered over SMS with automatic code extraction and accessible form input.

guides.title: Build Accessible Switch Controls
guides.description: Build an accessible switch with the native HTML switch attribute, falling back to a styled checkbox when not supported.

guides.title: Validate Input After Interaction
guides.description: Show form field validation feedback (e.g. password complexity or email format requirements) only after the user has finished their initial interaction, avoiding premature errors on page load or while the user is typing.

guides.title: Accessible Web Components
guides.description: Make custom elements accessible by default, setting roles and ARIA state via the ElementInternals ARIA mixin, managing focus with delegatesFocus, and keeping ARIA relationships within a single shadow root.

guides.title: Custom Elements
guides.description: Define, register, and manage the lifecycle of autonomous custom elements, covering constructor rules, lifecycle callbacks, upgrade timing, attribute/property reflection, and naming conventions.

guides.title: Form-Associated Custom Elements
guides.description: Make a custom control participate natively in forms with formAssociated and ElementInternals, submitting its own value, integrating with constraint validation, and reacting to reset, disable, and state-restore.

guides.title: Pre-rendering custom elements
guides.description: Server-render a custom element, then hydrate it in place without re-rendering or a flash of unstyled content.

guides.title: Shadow DOM, Templates & Slots
guides.description: Encapsulate a component's DOM and styles with Shadow DOM, construct the tree efficiently with HTML templates, and project consumer content with slots.

guides.title: Styling Web Components
guides.description: Style across the shadow boundary with :host selectors, inherited and custom properties for theming, ::slotted and ::part, and cascade layers and container queries inside components.

guides.title: Calculating Event Differentials with Temporal
guides.description: Calculate the duration and time remaining between dates and times.

guides.title: Capturing Location-Agnostic Data with Temporal
guides.description: Record chronological data that should not change based on a user's location, such as birthdates, recurring alarms, or national holidays.

guides.title: Coordinating Global Events with Temporal
guides.description: Schedule future meetings or events by explicitly binding them to a geographical IANA time zone so that event times remain accurate regardless of Daylight Saving Time (DST) transitions, "skipped" or "repeated" hours during clock changes.

guides.title: Formatting Human-Readable Durations with Temporal
guides.description: Present elapsed time or durations to users in a readable, localized format, with the flexibility to display either detailed unit breakdowns (e.g., "1 hour and 30 minutes") or total unit counts (e.g., "90 minutes") depending on context.

guides.title: Managing Recurring Intervals with Temporal
guides.description: Calculate recurring intervals for subscription billings or payroll cycles, automatically adjusting for edge cases such as month-end transitions (e.g., adding one month to January 31st) to ensure accurate period calculations.

guides.title: Modeling Partial Time Concepts with Temporal
guides.description: Model date and time concepts that inherently lack a standard component (such as a specific year, day, or date) without using arbitrary placeholder values that introduce calculation errors.

guides.title: Sequencing Distributed Events
guides.description: Sort timestamped events collected from servers, databases, or log files and measure the intervals between them.

guides.title: Stabilize Reactive State with Temporal
guides.description: Manage task deadlines or schedules in data-driven views without unexpected side effects from shared mutable state.

guides.title: Supporting Global Calendar Systems with Temporal
guides.description: Display and calculate dates in non-Gregorian calendar systems (e.g., Islamic, Hebrew, or Chinese) accurately for international users.

guides.title: Avoid redundant large asset downloads
guides.description: Avoid re-downloading and re-storing large shared assets, such as AI models, Wasm modules, or fully-bundled JavaScript libraries, that a visitor's browser may already hold from an unrelated site.

guides.title: Debounce and batch multiple analytics events
guides.description: Debounce and batch multiple analytics, telemetry, and Core Web Vitals events together in a single beacon to minimize network contention and reduce server load, while still delivering real-time updates.

guides.title: Break Up Long Tasks
guides.description: Break up heavy synchronous processing (complex computations and/or long loops) or DOM updates, to let the browser handle user input and repaint the screen.

guides.title: Calculate total foreground time
guides.description: Calculate the total time a user actually spent viewing a page, excluding periods when the tab was in the background.

guides.title: Conditional Async Dependencies
guides.description: Conditionally load or initialize async dependencies (such as importing polyfills for missing web features) without requiring complex orchestration across all of a page's script dependencies.

guides.title: Defer rendering heavy content
guides.description: Reduce rendering times in content-heavy web pages (e.g. pages with long feeds, lots of articles, or complex dashboards), by deferring rendering for any content that is not immediately visible to the user.

guides.title: Defer Work Until Scroll Ends
guides.description: Defer expensive operations like DOM updates, data fetching, analytics tracking, or layout recalculation until after scrolling completes to maintain smooth scroll performance.

guides.title: Deliver Optimized Decorative Images
guides.description: Deliver optimized decorative images (such as backgrounds, UI icons, or complex masks) by simultaneously providing next-generation image formats (like AVIF or WebP) alongside multiple pixel densities (like 1x and 2x) so the browser can dynamically negotiate the best combination of file size and visual quality for the user's device capabilities.

guides.title: Deprioritize background fetches
guides.description: Deprioritize background data fetches made with the Fetch API to prevent network contention with user-initiated requests.

guides.title: Detect Initial Visibility State
guides.description: Reliably determine whether a page was initially loaded in the background, even in cases where the script is loaded asynchronously after the user foregrounded the page.

guides.title: Efficient Background Processing
guides.description: Conserve system resources and battery life by pausing background JavaScript execution (such as `<canvas>` animations, WebGL rendering, or high-frequency WebSocket data polling) when the component is off-screen and then resume them just-in-time when they scroll back into view.

guides.title: Faster SPA View Transitions via State Caching
guides.description: Enable faster transitions back to previously visited views in a Single-Page Application (SPA) by preserving their structural DOM state instead of destroying and rebuilding them on every navigation.

guides.title: Flicker-Free Client-Side A/B Testing
guides.description: Deliver and render A/B tests, multi-variate tests, or other experiments using client-side JavaScript to alter or inject HTML, CSS, and JavaScript without the original content showing first before flickering or flashing to show the experiment content.

guides.title: Reliably measure full-session analytics and telemetry
guides.description: Reliably track analytics, Core Web Vitals, errors, and telemetry data across the user's entire page visit, and defer sending of the data until the user leaves the page.

guides.title: Identify heavy-running JavaScript
guides.description: Identify the scripts most responsible for long animation frames

guides.title: Identify causes of poor INP
guides.description: Identify slow-running JavaScript and other causes of poor Interaction to Next Paint (INP) responsiveness.

guides.title: Improve next page load performance
guides.description: Improve page load performance by prefetching or prerendering pages that the user is likely to visit next.

guides.title: Measure interaction and soft-navigation paint timing
guides.description: Measure the time it takes for user interactions and client-side navigations to render new contentful updates on screen.

guides.title: Optimizing Interactions in Complex Layouts
guides.description: Make interactions snappier and more responsive (reducing Interaction to Next Paint (INP) scores) by avoiding layout re-calculations in complex layouts, such as data-heavy dashboards or spreadsheet-style grids.

guides.title: Lazy load video and audio
guides.description: Defer downloading offscreen video and audio assets, including video poster images and preloaded media data, until the media player approaches the viewport to conserve bandwidth and reduce network contention during initial page load.

guides.title: Load shared resources declaratively
guides.description: Serve popular, unmodified scripts, stylesheets, and JavaScript modules from a shared cross-origin cache using markup or import syntax alone, without writing custom caching logic.

guides.title: Optimize image priority
guides.description: Optimize the loading priority of Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) candidate images and deprioritize non-critical images to reduce critical resource load delays.

guides.title: Optimize preload priority
guides.description: Optimize the relative priority of preloaded content to reduce critical resource load delays.

guides.title: Optimize script priority
guides.description: Optimize the loading priority of scripts by boosting critical asynchronous scripts and deprioritizing non-essential or late-body scripts to improve sequencing and reduce delays.

guides.title: optimize-scroll-stability
guides.description: Keep the page layout, scroll bar, and scroll position as stable as possible as users scroll through content-heavy pages (feeds, dashboards, long lists) where elements transition from hidden to visible.

guides.title: Performance
guides.description: Actionable guidelines for optimizing modern web applications. Use this guide when auditing performance, optimizing loading metrics, fixing slow interactions and optimizing Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS)

guides.title: Resolution Optimized Pseudo Elements
guides.description: Use resolution-optimized images in CSS pseudo-elements (such as `::before` and `::after`) to reduce the number of DOM nodes.

guides.title: Schedule Tasks By Priority
guides.description: Schedule tasks with different priorities to ensure critical work runs first while background work is deferred.

guides.title: serve-alternative-image-formats
guides.description: Deliver optimized decorative images (such as backgrounds, UI icons, or complex masks) by simultaneously providing next-generation image formats (like AVIF or WebP) alongside multiple pixel densities (like 1x and 2x) so the browser can dynamically negotiate the best combination of file size and visual quality for the user's device capabilities.

guides.title: Share web fonts across origins
guides.description: Serve large, popular web fonts from a shared cross-origin cache instead of re-downloading them from a font CDN on every site that references them.

guides.title: Migrating the Origin of an Installed Web App
guides.description: Transfer an installed web app to a new origin while preserving user configuration and OS-level shortcuts.

guides.title: Encrypt data client-side with WebCrypto
guides.description: Establish shared secrets using public-key encapsulation or key agreement—including hybrid and post-quantum protection—and encrypt sensitive data in the browser with authenticated encryption.

guides.title: Sign and verify data with WebCrypto
guides.description: Sign and verify messages, tokens, or artifacts in the browser using classical or quantum-resistant (post-quantum) asymmetric keys to ensure data integrity and authenticity.

guides.title: Local Network Access
guides.description: Access resources on a user's local network or loopback interface from a public web application.

guides.title: Passkey Authentication
guides.description: Authenticate a returning user with a passkey for primary sign-in.

guides.title: Passkey Conditional Create (Post-Login Promotion)
guides.description: Silently register a passkey for an existing user after a successful password login.

guides.title: Passkey Management
guides.description: Let users view and manage the passkeys registered to their account.

guides.title: Passkey Reauthentication
guides.description: Verify a signed-in user's identity using their existing passkeys before a sensitive action.

guides.title: Passkey Registration
guides.description: Register a passkey for an existing user account.

guides.title: Quick sign-ins with immediate UI mode
guides.description: Authenticate returning users in place with their saved passkeys or passwords before navigating to a sign-in page or interrupting their workflow.

guides.title: Restrict outbound network connections with Connection Allowlists
guides.description: Restrict a page or worker to communicating only with an explicit allowlist of network endpoints to prevent unauthorized third-party requests and client-side data exfiltration.

guides.title: Sanitizing Untrusted HTML
guides.description: Safely parse and display untrusted HTML content from user input by removing unsafe elements and attributes.

guides.title: Secure external subresources with Subresource Integrity, CORS, and Referrer Policy
guides.description: Verify the cryptographic integrity of external scripts, stylesheets, fonts, and images loaded from third-party origins, and control whether those requests send credentials or referrer URLs.

guides.title: Prevent DOM-based XSS attacks with Trusted Types
guides.description: Help prevent DOM-based XSS attacks by locking down dangerous DOM sinks so they reject raw strings and only accept policy-validated HTML.

guides.title: Compare and validate web origins and sites
guides.description: Compare and validate web origins and sites safely across cross-document messages and URLs without error-prone string parsing.

guides.title: Verify email address ownership
guides.description: Verify that a user owns an email address during account creation, sign-in, or recovery without sending a one-time passcode or magic link email.

guides.title: Build Carousel Slide Effects
guides.description: Create a carousel of slides with images or other visual elements, where each slide animates as they enter/center/exit their scroller. For example, the slides may fade-in/fade-out, rotate, get bigger or smaller, etc.

guides.title: Component-specific light/dark themes
guides.description: Force certain elements to be in light mode or dark mode (e.g. code blocks, media players, etc) independently of the page's color-scheme.

guides.title: Using and managing icons
guides.description: Display and manage icons that can be set and parameterized from CSS, are fast to load, crisp at any resolution and are properly exposed to (or hidden from) assistive technologies.

guides.title: Position Aware Tooltips
guides.description: Build tooltips and popovers with directional arrows (or other visual styling) that automatically point the correct way when the element flips to a fallback position.

guides.title: Pull to Reveal
guides.description: Build a pull-to-reveal feature that would enable the user to pull down on the screen to reveal more content, like a search bar.

guides.title: Responsive tables
guides.description: Build a data table that presents tabular data with proper header semantics, and remains readable and navigable on small screens and with assistive technologies.

guides.title: Scroll Position Aware Elements
guides.description: Build floating buttons or widgets (back-to-top, scroll-to-bottom, chat launchers, etc.) that appear and disappear based on whether the user has scrolled at all.

guides.title: Build a Scroll Progress Indicator
guides.description: Create a scroll progress bar, stepped progress tracker, or any visual affordance that communicates how far through a page or section the user has scrolled.

guides.title: Scrollability Affordance Hints
guides.description: Build scroll-shadow overlays, gradient fades, or directional arrow indicators that appear only when there's actually more content to scroll to in that direction.

guides.title: Shrinking header on scroll
guides.description: Smoothly animate a fixed header or full-page cover on scroll to dynamically shrink, gain shadows, and transform its layout over a predefined scroll distance.

guides.title: State-Aware Sticky Headers
guides.description: Build sticky section headers or navbars that visually transform when they're actually "stuck" at the top, changing their color scheme or gaining a shadow.

guides.title: Viewport-Aware Dropdowns
guides.description: Position dropdowns, flyouts, or contextual action panels tethered to a trigger button so they automatically flip axes at viewport edges instead of getting clipped.

guides.title: Two-Dimensional Panning
guides.description: Allow users to freely pan or scroll two-dimensional surfaces—such as maps, zoomed images, infinite canvases, or large data grids—across both directions (whether diagonally or changing direction mid-gesture) without the gesture locking to a single horizontal or vertical axis.

guides.title: Anchor Positioning Tab Underline
guides.description: Transition an element seamlessly between two target element positions. For example, moving a selected tab underline between the previously selected tab and the currently selected tab.

guides.title: Animate Element Entry and Exit
guides.description: Smoothly hide/show elements as they are added/removed from the DOM or as their display values are toggled.

guides.title: Animate Elements To and From Top Layer
guides.description: Animate elements such as dialogs, popovers, and tooltips as they're entering/exiting the top layer.

guides.title: Carousel Snap Highlights
guides.description: Visually highlight the currently snapped non-interactive item in scroll-snapping carousels, galleries, or full-page swipe experiences. For example, expanding a card when snapped, or revealing hidden content.

guides.title: Consistent Cross-Document Transitions
guides.description: Ensure critical page state is loaded and stable before initiating a cross-document view transition. This means critical CSS styles are loaded and applied, critical JavaScript is loaded and run, and the HTML visible for the user's initial view of the page has been parsed before the transition runs.

guides.title: Cross-Document Transitions
guides.description: Create smooth, seamless transitions between full page navigations, such as cross-fades, custom reveal effects, or morphing of content from one page to the next.

guides.title: Custom Button Actions
guides.description: Declaratively connect a button to any element to trigger custom, application-specific actions using declarative button commands, invoker commands, button commands, custom commands, or declarative toggle actions.

guides.title: Declarative Dialog and Popover Control
guides.description: Toggle the visibility of a dialog or popover from a button without writing JavaScript.

guides.title: Directional Navigation Transitions
guides.description: Animate visual state changes to reflect the direction of a user's navigational flow, such as sliding new content in from the right when advancing forward or from the left when returning to a previous screen.

guides.title: Build a Draggable Element
guides.description: Support dragging to move a floating element around the page.

guides.title: Creating a stagger animation
guides.description: Stagger animation or transition timing across sibling elements so each one starts after a computed delay based on its position in the sibling list.

guides.title: Group Element Transitions
guides.description: Transition a group of similar elements simultaneously using the same transition logic, such as removing a product from a shopping cart and having all the other products animate into their new positions.

guides.title: Highlight Text Ranges
guides.description: Highlight arbitrary text ranges on a page such as search results, spelling errors, or collaborative editing cursors.

guides.title: Interactive Content Reveal
guides.description: Create interactive reveal effects, such as a spotlight that follows the user's pointer to uncover details within an image or UI section.

guides.title: Interest Triggered Action Previews
guides.description: Show a live preview of a button's effect when a user signals interest (e.g. hovering, focusing, or long-pressing) but before they commit to clicking.

guides.title: Show a tooltip when hovering
guides.description: Show a tooltip or supplemental information when a user hovers over, focuses on, or long-presses an interactive element, without requiring a click.

guides.title: Light-Dismiss a Dialog
guides.description: Create a modal dialog that can be closed via light dismiss (i.e. clicking or tapping outside of the dialog)

guides.title: Motion
guides.description: Animate UI with CSS transitions, animations, scroll-driven animations, and view transitions while keeping motion on the compositor and respecting reduced-motion preferences.

guides.title: Move DOM Element Without Losing State
guides.description: Move or reparent a DOM element without losing important element state, such as interactivity states (:focus/:active), `<iframe>` loading state, animation/transition state, etc

guides.title: Build a Parallax Effect on Scroll
guides.description: Create scroll-based effects (such as parallax) where foreground and background layers move at different rates, creating a sense of depth as the user scrolls.

guides.title: Persistent Top Layer UI
guides.description: Keep a modal dialog, fullscreen element, or native popover visibly open and functionally active when its underlying DOM node is moved or reparented in the DOM.

guides.title: Physics Based Easing
guides.description: Create custom, physics-based animation and transition effects, like bounce and spring, that feel more natural and engaging than traditional easing curves.

guides.title: Platform Controls Dismiss Dialog
guides.description: Create a modal dialog that can be closed via standard platform-specific user actions, such as pressing the `Esc` key on desktop platforms, or a "back" or "dismiss" gesture on mobile platforms

guides.title: Prevent the Page Underneath a Modal Dialog from Scrolling
guides.description: Prevent the underlying page from scrolling while a modal dialog is open.

guides.title: Same Document Transitions
guides.description: Visually connect persisting elements across different page states or navigations in a Single Page Application (SPA) (e.g. expanding a product thumbnail into a full-bleed hero image) by smoothly morphing their size, position, or other styling properties.

guides.title: Scoped Component Transitions
guides.description: Animate state changes inside a single component (a card, list, panel, or other subtree) while the rest of the page remains interactive, and other transitions run concurrently.

guides.title: Triggering Effects After Programmatic Scrolling Completes
guides.description: Trigger visual effects, animations, or focus changes on a target element only after a smooth programmatic scroll to that element has finished.

guides.title: Add entry and exit effects to elements as they enter or exit the scrollport
guides.description: Create fade-in, scale-up, or other complex reveal-type effects on elements as they enter and exit the scrollport (or viewport) while the user is scrolling.

guides.title: Scroll Snap Real-Time Feedback
guides.description: Provide real-time visual feedback in linked UI elements while a user scrolls through snap-aligned content, before the scroll gesture completes.

guides.title: Scroll Snap State Sync
guides.description: Synchronize navigation indicators, linked content panels, and analytics tracking with the actively snapped item in a scrollable container.

guides.title: Set a scroll target for the initial render
guides.description: Build a scrollable list of elements (e.g. a carousel of images or a chat conversation thread) that can be displayed with a particular element scrolled into view on the initial render.

guides.title: Scrollytelling
guides.description: Animate visual properties on a target element — such as fading a backdrop, shifting a background color, or to create scrollytelling experiences — driven entirely by the scrollport position of a completely different element.

guides.title: Search hidden content
guides.description: Hide content from view using patterns such as accordions, tabs, and "Read more" sections, while ensuring the hidden text reveals itself during native "Find in page" searches, allows search engine indexing, supports URL fragment deep links, and maintains ARIA accessibility.

guides.title: Spatial Navigation (Directional Keypad Focus)
guides.description: Implement accessible spatial navigation using arrow keys that works correctly in different layout modes (grid etc)

guides.title: Swipe to remove
guides.description: Let users act on items in a list (remove, archive, mark as read, etc.) with a horizontal swipe gesture, so they can process entries quickly without tapping a separate control.

guides.title: Swipe to reveal
guides.description: Let users swipe horizontally on a list item or content pane to reveal contextual action buttons or a side menu without automatically triggering an action.

guides.title: Build a Card
guides.description: Build a card component that adapts its presentation to its own available space and contents.

guides.title: Styling Checkboxes
guides.description: Style checkboxes, including custom icons, layout, colors, check/uncheck animations, while preserving native functionality and accessibility.

guides.title: Build an interactive hovercard
guides.description: Build a hovercard component that displays an interactive structured preview of the page a certain type of link (e.g. a user profile) will navigate to when hovered over.

guides.title: Build a dropdown menu
guides.description: Build a menu component that displays a list of options or actions, with support for nested submenus.

guides.title: Navigation Drawer
guides.description: Create a navigation drawer component that, when triggered from a menu button, slides in from the side overlaid on top of existing page content, and slides out when dismissed (by swiping away, tapping outside, or pressing escape).

guides.title: Creating Persistent App Tours
guides.description: Create persistent onboarding walkthroughs using tethered native overlays that stay open during user interaction.

guides.title: Creating Toast Notifications
guides.description: Create non-intrusive toast and overlay notifications for persistent, stackable messaging and state communication.

guides.title: Build a Styled Progress Bar
guides.description: Build a styled progress bar that communicates completion of a task or process, in both determinate and indeterminate states.

guides.title: Progress ring
guides.description: Build a progress ring component that visually represents the completion status of a task or process, with support for content in the center and brand-consistent styling.

guides.title: Build a Scrollspy Navigation
guides.description: Highlight the currently visible section of a page in a navigation menu

guides.title: Loading spinner
guides.description: Build a loading spinner that communicates busy state to all users, respects reduced-motion preferences, and animates efficiently.

guides.title: Stack Drill Down
guides.description: Build full-screen hierarchical navigation that lets users drill down into nested views and swipe or navigate back to return, with browser history kept in sync.

guides.title: Adapt scrollbar to high-contrast preferences
guides.description: Enhance scrollbar visibility for users who prefer high-contrast interfaces

guides.title: Apply WebGL shaders to HTML content
guides.description: Apply custom visual effects with WebGL shaders to HTML content.

guides.title: Theming browser-generated UI
guides.description: Theme browser-generated UI such as text selection, scrollbars, form controls, and pickers with CSS instead of re-creating it with custom elements.

guides.title: Complex Shapes
guides.description: Clip elements and their content to any free-form shape, like a symbol, brush stroke, or organic texture for more expressive designs.

guides.title: Ensure text readability with dynamic background colors
guides.description: Select a readable text color with sufficient contrast on a dynamic background color.

guides.title: Custom text decorations
guides.description: Add text decorations such as underlines, overlines, strikethroughs, or entirely custom shapes, with reveal animations, custom offsets and end insets, and flexible ink skipping.

guides.title: Customize the color or thickness of a scrollbar
guides.description: Customize the color or thickness of a scrollbar

guides.title: Dark mode
guides.description: Implement dark mode support in a way that respects the user's light/dark theme preference and adapts browser UI (e.g. scrollbars, form controls, etc)

guides.title: Equal-Width Text Lines
guides.description: Make every line of a multi-line heading or lockup span the same width, as in poster-style or stacked-headline typography. Unlike justified text, the text itself is sized to the width rather than the spacing stretched

guides.title: Export HTML content from canvas
guides.description: Capture and export dynamic HTML content as images or video frames from within canvas.

guides.title: Expose canvas content to browser features
guides.description: Expose content rendered in a canvas to browser features like assistive technologies, translation, or reading mode.

guides.title: Improve Text Layout and Legibility
guides.description: Improve the layout and legibility of short standalone text content, such as headings no longer than a few lines, by enabling the browser to apply evenly balanced line breaks when wrapping text.

guides.title: Enable interactive HTML content in 3D scenes
guides.description: Integrate interactive HTML elements into a 3D scene.

guides.title: Precise Text Alignment
guides.description: Achieve precise vertical alignment with text of any font. For example, exactly equal visual padding above and below text, or aligning text perfectly flush with adjacent icons or images.

guides.title: Shaped Cutouts
guides.description: Combine multiple shapes to create complex cutouts or 'knockout' effects in elements, such as adding a notch to an element.

guides.title: Soft Edge Content Fade
guides.description: Apply a transparency gradient to content edges to indicate further scrollable areas or to obscure payment-walled text.

guides.title: Visually Stable Font Fallbacks
guides.description: Define font styles such that text remains readable and visually consistent in the event that there's a swap between the preferred font and one of the fallbacks (or vice versa).

guides.title: Visually Stable Mixed Fonts
guides.description: Define font styles such that text remains readable and visually consistent in situations where multiple fonts are used to render a single block of text.

guides.title: Visually Texture Content
guides.description: Apply realistic weathering and texture patterns to elements to give them an organic, aged, or physical material appearance.

guides.title: Agentic Forms
guides.description: Expose client-side functionality as tools to AI agents by annotating standard HTML forms with WebMCP attributes.

guides.title: Agentic JavaScript Tools
guides.description: Programmatically register client-side JavaScript functions as tools for AI agents using the WebMCP Imperative API.
